theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners (GDX) show the cleanest trend-discipline composite among eligible themes: rank 3, trend hurst tag, very high breadth (0.917), low crowding (z=0.19), and a high durability bar (0.73). Under the logic of the validated absolute-trend gate, this is a stay-in-the-trend name; the breadth suggests participation, not a single-stock spike.
theses.dissent: Precious-metal miners are highly volatile and a crowded macro trade in disguise; a sudden real-yield spike or strong-dollar move can cut them without warning, and the detector's cross-sectional rank has no forward edge.

falsifier.text: GDX closes below its trend gate (eligibility flips to false) before the check-by date.

theses.dissent: Silver is more industrial than gold; if global growth disappoints, silver's industrial demand leg can dominate and SIL can lag GDX sharply even if both are 'miners'.

falsifier.text: SMH breaks out to new relative highs and holds them for ten consecutive sessions before the check-by date.
